stage: V2-R3 minimal fix implementation + targeted evaluation

REQUIRED_TERM_COVERAGE_MIN_RATIO.meaning: Minimum fraction of a multi-term query's required terms (primary tokens, or bigrams for an unsegmented CJK compound) that must be found in a candidate's title/tags blob for the query's subject to be considered present (gates missing_subject_penalty / path_agreement). A majority, not all terms.
REQUIRED_TERM_COVERAGE_MIN_RATIO.source: design doc 05_V2_R3_MINIMAL_FIX_DESIGN.md section 5.3 qualitative principle ("majority, not 100%"); 0.5 taken directly as the numeric instantiation of that principle and confirmed sufficient against the calibration set on the first attempt -- no iteration was needed.

ISOLATED_HIT_MAX_COVERAGE_RATIO.meaning: Maximum coverage ratio at or below which a candidate's whole-token evidence is considered isolated (single-signal) and has its whole_token contribution capped, unless corroborated by an exact-phrase hit.
ISOLATED_HIT_MAX_COVERAGE_RATIO.source: Same as above -- deliberately kept equal to REQUIRED_TERM_COVERAGE_MIN_RATIO so a candidate at exactly the coverage boundary can still pass the subject-presence gate while remaining capped on raw score (two independent, composable signals; see relevanceScorer.ts scoreRecord comment).

ISOLATED_HIT_SCORE_CAP.meaning: Cap on the combined whole_token_title + whole_token_tags contribution when the isolated-hit condition is met (instead of allowing both weights, 18+8=26, to stack).
ISOLATED_HIT_SCORE_CAP.source: Set equal to the existing whole_token_tags weight (8) -- an isolated single-term hit should score like a medium-confidence tag match, not a strong title match plus a tag match. Taken directly from design doc section 5.2's proposed default and confirmed sufficient against calibration on the first attempt.

adjustment_history.action: Initial values taken directly from design doc's qualitative principles (majority coverage, cap = whole_token_tags weight).
adjustment_history.reason: Design doc section 5.3 explicitly deferred exact numeric calibration to the implementation stage, against the calibration set only.
adjustment_history.calibration_result_at_this_round: 5/14 calibration cases IMPROVED, 0/14 REGRESSED, 9/14 UNCHANGED (see 07_V0_R1_R3_TARGETED_COMPARISON.csv) -- net positive on first attempt, no further adjustment performed.

adjustment_rounds_max_allowed_note: Charter allows a limited number of rounds, calibration-only, no per-query hand-tuning. Exactly one round (the initial design-derived default) was needed and used; no holdout-informed or per-query adjustment was made at any point.
case_split_file_hash_method: SHA-256 over the newline-joined, sorted 'query_id|query' pairs within each set_name subset (per-set hashes); whole-file hash also recorded separately.
code_diff_hash_scope: git diff over exactly the 4 files changed this stage: app/[locale]/(public)/search/page.tsx, lib/relevanceScorer.ts, lib/relevanceScorerConfig.ts, lib/__tests__/relevanceScorer.test.ts (pre-commit working tree diff against pre_commit_sha).
